title: A model is chosen as the default
description: data of likho.model.chosen.v1; published by likho-ml on NATS subject likho.model.chosen when an admin makes another model the default. likho-transcription uses it for the next job (it also asks likho-ml now and then, so a missed event is not a stuck default).
